page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose cloud server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture and KVM virtualization, it provides 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores with 2.0 threads per core. The instance comes configured with 64 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4 GB per virtual core. It includes no local storage or GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached volumes for persistence, and features a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals distinct execution profiles for single-threaded and multi-threaded workloads. Single-core tests, such as stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core, place in the bottom 25 percentile. In contrast, multi-core CPU performance falls into the middle 50 percentile across stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and Geekbench multi-core evaluations. The CPU includes AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI vector instruction sets. Memory throughput and application benchmarks exhibit steady average performance, delivering 11.35 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and 9.98 GB/sec static web serving throughput.

With its standard resource allocation and dedicated core model, the ecs.sn2.3xlarge offers cost efficiency for applications requiring moderate parallel compute density without local disk overhead. The main tradeoffs involve weak single-thread processor performance and the requirement for external storage configuration. This server type is best suited for general-purpose web serving, caching systems like Redis, multi-threaded background processing, and software compilation tasks.
